desc: Ideation: minimum-weight paths need at most 3 edges (co-interval graph + positive weights).
Parse N, W, intervals, Q, queries; precompute bestR[c]/bestL[c] prefix/suffix minima over 0..2N+1 with INF.
Per-query: disjoint case → W_s+W_t; intersecting case → W_s+W_t+min(bestR[min(Ls,Lt)], bestL[max(Rs,Rt)], bestR[Ls]+bestL[Rt], bestL[Rs]+bestR[Lt]) or -1.
Reproduce both provided samples exactly (11,6,-1 and 157,124,-1,114,114).
Brute-force stress test vs. Dijkstra/BFS on random small inputs confirmed correctness (paths, disconnected cases, no optimal path beyond 3 edges).
